entities.name: Query DAN4-like protein
observations: 802-aa sequence; 94.5% identity to reviewed Saccharomyces cerevisiae DAN4 (UniProt P47179), with 100% query coverage; strong evidence for a DAN4-family cell-wall protein.
Contains Pfam SRP1_TIP1 domain PF00660 at residues 25–116.
Sequence-derived estimates: 81.7 kDa, pI 4.38, GRAVY −0.254; sequence is highly Ser/Thr-rich and repetitive in its C-terminal region.

entities.name: DAN4 (UniProt P47179)
observations: Reviewed Saccharomyces cerevisiae cell-wall protein; annotated as secreted and associated with cell wall, cell membrane, and GPI anchor.
